---
name: New component or archetype
about: Propose a new packages/core component, or a new @rebar-ui/placement archetype
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Which one is this?**
- [ ] A new component in `packages/core` (a new primitive/pattern, not yet covered)
- [ ] A new archetype in `@rebar-ui/placement` (a reusable content shape the current 15 don't fit)

**What does it need to express?**
Describe the content/UI shape — a real example is more useful than an abstract description (e.g.
"a settings-form archetype with grouped sections" beats "a form variant").

**Why isn't an existing component/archetype enough?**
Check `dist/index.d.ts` (component) or `packages/placement/README.md`'s archetype table
(archetype) first — this helps confirm it's a genuine gap, not a composition of what already
exists.

**Reference (optional)**
A screenshot, a link to how another library does it, or a rough sketch — anything that shows the
intended shape.
